title: Agent-message tampering and citation integrity
objective: Determine whether downstream solution generation validates retrieval evidence provenance.
input: Copy a legitimate retrieval response in an isolated component test. Alter one source ID, source status or content in the copied message before passing it to the downstream solution component.
expected: Manipulated evidence must not become trusted source attribution or an unsupported recommendation. Final citations should match verified source records.
procedure: Inspect the real internal component interface before testing. Do not change the production database or claim that a direct component weakness is automatically exposed through HTTP.
evidence: Original and altered messages, component inputs and outputs, source verification, citations and scope limitations.
